commit.message:
test(l8): chot mien bo sinh ky tu va o cau truc cua bang dot A (#1539, no WP1236-B02)

c36: san dem A_CA thay bang so DUNG (o cau truc + so lan x mien bo sinh, hang
chep tu dac ta bo-sinh-bat-bien r1); them chot tap general category va ky tu
ngoai BMP tren cac phan tu DA qua main -> L8.
c37: vu tru ky tu dung 158 (128 ASCII + 29 category tru Cs + mot ngoai BMP),
so o la hang 648, kiem TRUOC vong o.
c39, c40: phan chung P1-P6 chay CHINH c37/c36 voi bo sinh / ca a129 bi sua
trong bo nho; moi chot mot bien the rieng.
Test dot A: kiem_bo_sinh + a135 (nam bo doi so), a136 (P7, sau bo sinh gia).

Khong sua module san pham.

commit.message:
test(l8): chot so phan tu KHAC NHAU va phan chung rieng cho tong 158 / 648 (#1539, review ma luot 1)

R1-02: c36 them chot thu tu — so phan tu khac nhau (ho so + moi tep provenance,
so tung byte) = so phan tu tru so gap lai co chu y (hang, co dan giai tung ca).
Mot o cau truc bi thay bang BAN SAO o khac nay DO o ca tam ca; c40 chay dung
cap nguon/dich cua reviewer tren a129 va mot cap tuong tu tren a126.
R1-01: c39 them bien the lap CHINH ky tu ngoai BMP cuoi (chi menh de tong 158
bat) va c37 mat MOT o roi qua ban sao trong bo nho (chi chot 648 bat); ky8 trong
c39 nay DEM o: phan chung 0 o, ban nguyen ven dung 648 o.
c40: doi chung a129 nguyen ven di cung duong nho dem; nho dem yaml theo doi so
dung chung cho moi bien the.

commit.message:
test(l8): phan chung cho TUNG chieu sai cua moi chot moi (#1539, review ma luot 2)

R2-01: c40 them "them mot ban sao o dau" tren a126 (53 phan tu, 52 khac nhau)
de khoa chieu THUA cua chot so phan tu; them "ky vong gap lai +1" de khoa chieu
thua cua chot so phan tu khac nhau; hai phia bien BMP (U+FFFF do, U+10000 xanh).
c39: c37 thua mot o roi (649), hai phia bien BMP cua vu tru, nap_sua phai do khi
neo xuat hien 0 lan / nhieu lan.
a136: bo sinh rong, thua mot ngoai BMP, ngoai BMP sai vi tri voi cuoi la U+FFFF,
dai dien U+007F, cuoi la U+10000 (xanh).
Thoi gian: nho dem PyYAML theo doi so chuyen vao c36 (dung chung so voi moi luot
c40 chay lai c36); a136 nho dem bo sinh.

commit.message:
test(l8): chot danh tinh mien doi so cua bo sinh, phan chung tung bo, doi chung a131 (#1539, review ma luot 3)

R3-01: kiem_bo_sinh ghi lai cac bo doi so da kiem va so voi tap (cam, bo_loai)
doc bang AST tu chinh cac loi goi bo sinh trong cac ca cua dot A (doc lap voi
BO_SINH_MONG), dung nam bo. a136 them nam bo sinh gia moi cai chi sai tai dung
mot bo, va BO_SINH_MONG bi bo / lap / thay mot bo hoac cac ca dung sau bo.
R3-02: c40 them doi chung a131 nguyen ven (ca khong goi bo sinh) de nhanh
`if tru is not None` khong roi vao loi vo can.
R3-03: a135 va a136 dung chung bo nho dem ket qua bo sinh that, khoa theo chinh
doi tuong ham nen bo sinh gia cua a136 khong bi che.
